title_translated: 揭开语言模型强化学习后训练的神秘面纱
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）后训练已成为提升大语言模型（LLMs）能力的强大框架，使其在推理、数学和编程方面表现出色。然而，对许多研究人员和实践者而言，经典RL的基本原理仍是一个“黑箱”。在本研究中，我们剖析了RL后训练算法，逐步探究其内在机制，以揭示表面之下的真实情况。通过在受控且简化的环境中隔离RL与可验证奖励的机制，我们考察了基线模型的先验分布、奖励信号粒度、提示分布多样性以及模型规模如何影响RL结果。我们以策略输出分布的熵为视角，对比预训练、监督微调（SFT）和RL后训练所学习的分布，揭示各阶段如何塑造模型的确定性。我们的研究揭示了这些选择如何相互作用以影响后训练的成功。例如，我们展示了所谓“虚假奖励”的影响取决于后训练所用的提示分布。我们还深入探讨了RL后训练成功为何依赖于基线模型是否已在期望行为上分配足够的概率质量，从而将其与RL中的经典探索概念联系起来。最终，我们提供此入门指南，作为NLP社区希望将RL纳入工具箱的研究人员和实践者的资源。

summary: We present GreenLeaf Law Embed Tiny, a 0.6B parameter embedding model for legal domain retrieval. GreenLeaf-Tiny achieves 75.11% on the Massive Legal Embedding Benchmark (MLEB) and 64.38% on MTEB(Law, v1),demonstrating competitive performance among models under 1B parameters. Our approach combines a two-stage training pipeline that first distills knowledge from a larger teacher model into a compact student architecture, then applies domain-specific fine-tuning with hard negative mining; a carefully curated dataset of 3.4 million query-passage pairs, including 150,000 human-curated samples across diverse legal jurisdictions; and an efficient inference architecture supporting multiple quantization levels (BF16, INT8, binary) enabling deployment in resource-constrained environments. We provide detailed analysis of our training methodology, architectural choices, and comprehensive evaluation across legal retrieval tasks. Our results demonstrate that domain-specific training with high-quality data can improve performance for specialized domain applications
title: GreenLeaf Law Embed Tiny: A Compact Embedding Model for Legal Domain Retrieval
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, IEEE dual-column format. Submitted to arXiv for preprint distribution
title_translated: GreenLeaf Law Embed Tiny：一种用于法律领域检索的紧凑嵌入模型
summary_translated: 我们提出了GreenLeaf Law Embed Tiny，一个参数量为0.6B的法律领域检索嵌入模型。GreenLeaf-Tiny在大规模法律嵌入基准（MLEB）上达到75.11%的性能，在MTEB(Law, v1)上达到64.38%，展现出在10亿参数以下模型中具有竞争力的表现。我们的方法结合了两阶段训练流程：首先将大型教师模型的知识蒸馏到紧凑的学生架构中，然后通过硬负样本挖掘进行领域特定微调；使用了一个精心构建的包含340万条查询-段落对的数据集，其中包括跨多个法律管辖区的15万条人工标注样本；并设计了一种高效的推理架构，支持多种量化级别（BF16、INT8、二值化），可在资源受限环境中部署。我们对训练方法、架构选择以及法律检索任务中的全面评估进行了详细分析。结果表明，使用高质量数据进行领域特定训练可显著提升专用领域应用的性能。

summary: In health and nutrition consulting, widely used prompting methods pass the user profile as an unstructured block without a dedicated analysis step, leaving personalization as a critical structural gap. We introduce PA-CoT (Profile-Adaptive Chain-of-Thought), a multi-stage prompting method that treats profile interpretation as an explicit, standalone reasoning step prior to response generation. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce the QPA (Question--Profile--Answer) benchmark -- 200 nutritional consulting samples with structured user profiles scored on four criteria. In a comparative study against 11 comparison methods (CoT, Few-Shot, Role Prompting, DSPy, TextGrad, Self-Refine, and others, plus a Zero-Shot Baseline; 12 total including PA-CoT), PA-CoT achieves the best average score (4.21 on the G-Eval 1--5 scale) and leads on both Personalization (4.71 vs. 4.39) and Safety (4.68 vs. 4.52) with non-overlapping 95\% confidence intervals over the nearest competitor -- the only method to simultaneously top both criteria. The results confirm that an explicit profile-analysis step is the key driver of personalization gains over widely used prompting approaches.
title: PA-CoT: Profile-Adaptive Chain-of-Thought for Personalized Nutritional Consulting
comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Structured Data for Health (SD4H)
title_translated: PA-CoT：面向个性化营养咨询的自适应链式思维
summary_translated: 在健康与营养咨询中，广泛使用的提示方法将用户资料作为非结构化块传递，缺乏专门的分析步骤，导致个性化成为关键的结构性缺失。我们提出PA-CoT（Profile-Adaptive Chain-of-Thought），一种多阶段提示方法，将资料解析作为一个独立显式的推理步骤，置于响应生成之前。为实现系统性评估，我们引入QPA（问题-资料-答案）基准——包含200个营养咨询样本，其用户资料经过四个标准评分。在与11种对比方法（包括CoT、少样本学习、角色提示、DSPy、TextGrad、Self-Refine等，加上零样本基线，共12种方法）的对比研究中，PA-CoT在G-Eval 1–5量表上取得最高平均分（4.21），并在个性化（4.71 vs. 4.39）和安全性（4.68 vs. 4.52）两项指标上均以非重叠95%置信区间领先于最接近的竞争对手——是唯一同时在两项指标上领先的方案。结果证实，显式的资料分析步骤是实现个性化提升的关键驱动因素。

summary: We describe a practical architecture for making the Maritime Information Exchange Model (MIEM) and the broader Rich Semantic Track model tractable using current large language model (LLM) technology. The barrier to adoption of semantic track models in defense and law enforcement has been the requirement that operators learn formal ontology languages and manually encode observations as typed logical assertions. We propose eliminating this barrier entirely: operators contribute observations in natural language; an LLM translates these into typed Semantic Assertion Records (SARs), which are named case frames that capture n-ary relations in a single compact structure; a knowledge graph accumulates the SARs; and a second LLM pass performs inference, anomaly detection, and hypothesis ranking over the graph. We work through two detailed examples (a 9/11-era pre-attack indicator scenario and a maritime cargo inspection scenario) showing the full pipeline from natural language input to SAR representation to inference output. We argue that this architecture makes the Track Model and MIEM immediately deployable with current technology, establishes prior art against proprietary enclosure of the approach, and grounds the method in a theoretical framework connecting semantic track representations to neural manifold geometry.
title: Natural Language Input, Semantic Track Representation, and LLM Inference: Making the Maritime Information Exchange Model Tractable
title_translated: 自然语言输入、语义轨迹表示与大语言模型推理：使海事信息交换模型具备可行性
summary_translated: 我们描述了一种实用架构，利用当前的大语言模型（LLM）技术使海事信息交换模型（MIEM）及更广泛的丰富语义轨迹模型具备可行性。在国防和执法领域采用语义轨迹模型的主要障碍在于操作员需学习形式化本体语言，并手动将观测结果编码为类型化的逻辑断言。我们提出彻底消除这一障碍：操作员以自然语言提交观测；一个LLM将其转换为带类型的语义断言记录（SARs），即捕捉n元关系的单一紧凑结构；知识图谱累积这些SARs；第二个LLM阶段执行推理、异常检测和假设排序。我们通过两个详细案例（9/11前袭击预警情景和海事货物检查情景）展示了从自然语言输入到SAR表示再到推理输出的完整流程。我们认为该架构使轨迹模型和MIEM能够立即用现有技术部署，确立了该方法的先例，避免其被专有封闭，且在理论框架上将语义轨迹表示与神经流形几何联系起来。
